verdict.rationale: Pika is an AI creative platform, and background automations are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows one-off generation apps, plus an API and MCP server that a developer could use to build automations. Nothing documents user-configurable automations, recurring schedules, or autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
